title: Week 6 of making of a PoE inspired ARPG.
author: Ormusn2o
selftext:
After weeks, the project fundamentals are still not done, but it's getting close. It is very close to PoE, but simplified, offline and singleplayer only. Used Astra at the start, then 6.1 Sol, because I only have Plus account, which slows down the pace.

Probably won't be able to release it publicly, as it will likely use assets with no license for distribution, unless new AI models come out that are cheap and good at making 3d models and textures. Right now using Mixamo animations and models.

comments.author: PossibleAnteater4062
comments.body: Plug in blender so AI can make better assets what game Engine are you using ....? because Godot and Unity works the best and Opus 5.5 after 6 weeks would've pushed out more polished experience

replies.author: Ormusn2o
replies.body:
I'm using Flax https://flaxengine.com/ and yes, I already have blender, although I only made AI do very little changes as I'm focusing on engine and underlying architecture. I actually considered Godot and Unity, but they they don't have as much source control as Flax, and I wanted to strongly focus on fundamentals and performance. In one of the earlier videos you can see a hundred of enemies pathing toward me, and this game is going to have millions of actions happening every second, with individual projectiles, dot, changes in movement and so on, so I needed an engine strongly focused on performance that I could fine tune for performance.

And while Opus 5.5 is generally better at visuals, it is worse at the fundamentals and the solid and reliable code that I need for this project. It also was not out 6 weeks ago, it's not even been a month since it came out, and it's limits are worse than 6.1 Sol.
